Who We Are & Why Join Us

Avathon is the leading Industrial AI autonomy platform, helping customers across heavy industries -- energy, mining, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and logistics -- accelerate the journey toward autonomous operations. Our platform is built on a Computational Knowledge Graph foundation that contextualizes and connects operational data across siloed systems, bringing together time series, structured, unstructured, and machine vision data to power AI-driven applications in asset performance management, supply chain intelligence, visual AI, and global trade management. With capabilities spanning digital twins, normal behavior modeling, natural language processing, and computer vision, Avathon delivers real-time predictive intelligence and agentic decision-making at industrial scale.

Cutting-Edge AI Innovation -- Join a team at the forefront of AI, developing groundbreaking solutions that shape the future. High-Growth Environment -- Thrive in a fast-scaling startup where agility, collaboration, and rapid professional growth are the norm. Meaningful Impact -- Work on AI-driven projects that drive real change across industries and improve lives.

Learn more at: avathon.com

Brand Designer

Bangalore, India (in office) · Full-time · Reports to the Director of Marketing

We're looking for our design unicorn.

Industrial AI is one of the fastest-growing spaces in tech, and Avathon is growing with it. We're building our brand and creative team in Bangalore, and we want a designer who is exceptional at their craft, with taste and ideas we can learn from. You'll own how Avathon looks and tells its story, as a creative partner to marketing, sales, product and leadership. And you'll have a great time doing it with us.

Who We Are & Why Join Us

Avathon is the leading Industrial AI autonomy platform, helping customers across heavy industries - energy, mining, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and logistics - accelerate the journey toward autonomous operations. Our platform is built on a Computational Knowledge Graph foundation that contextualizes and connects operational data across siloed systems, bringing together time series, structured, unstructured, and machine vision data to power AI-driven applications in asset performance management, supply chain intelligence, visual AI, and global trade management. With capabilities spanning digital twins, normal behavior modeling, natural language processing, and computer vision, Avathon delivers real-time predictive intelligence and agentic decision-making at industrial scale.

Cutting-Edge AI Innovation - Join a team at the forefront of AI, developing groundbreaking solutions that shape the future.

High-Growth Environment - Thrive in a fast-scaling startup where agility, collaboration, and rapid professional growth are the norm.

Meaningful Impact - Work on AI-driven projects that drive real change across industries and improve lives.

What you'll do

Build the design system. As our first brand design leader, set it up from scratch with external partners, then own it in-house: the Figma library, templates and rules for using it.

Make other teams self-serve. Canva and slide templates so anyone can make on-brand material without waiting on design.

Design across marketing. Sales decks and one-pagers, campaigns, ads, social, the website, events and trade shows.

Make customer stories look like proof. Real sites, real people and one clear result per story.

Build our executive and talent brand. Visuals for our CEO's LinkedIn presence and for hiring campaigns.

AI in this role

Design is still a human process. The ideas, the taste and the original thinking come from you. But we want someone who hates grunt work (resizing, reformatting, repeating the same layout) so much that they automate it. We're building an AI-first marketing team, and you'll set up the design workflows that let us support the whole company:

End-to-end workflows. For example, a product launch → web page, one-pager, email, social and slides. AI drafts; you set the rules and make the final call.

Brand rules AI can follow. Prompts, templates and guardrails, so output is on-brand the first time.

Faster concepts. AI for moodboards, storyboards and resizing, finished by hand.

Our tools: Claude, Figma, Canva and Adobe. You'll help choose what we add.

What you bring

6–10 years in design, with 4–6 at B2B or SaaS brands, in-house or at an agency. We're not looking for B2C or consumer-only portfolios.

A portfolio from creative B2B brands known for great storytelling, including design systems or brand guidelines you built.

Strong layout and typography, and the judgement to make dense technical material clear.

A strong client focus, for both our customers and your internal partners across Avathon. You treat every team you design for as a client: you listen, ask the right questions, and deliver work that solves their problem.

Expert in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

You already use AI in your daily design work, and know where it falls short.

You'd rather build something once that saves 50 requests than do the 50 requests.

Clear written and spoken English, for daily work with teams in the US.

Nice to have

Motion or video editing, data visualisation, trade show graphics, web design, and experience in industrial, energy, manufacturing, aerospace or defence.

Who you are

This is a core team, so we're looking for senior people who can build systems, not just follow them.

High agency. You get things done without waiting to be told.

Curious. You ask why, learn the business, and bring ideas no one asked for.

No ego. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from.

Empathetic and a great listener. You understand what people need before you design for them.

A real team player. You make the people around you better, across teams and time zones.

Great Energy. You make building something new enjoyable.

How to apply

Send your CV and portfolio link, with one project where you built or extended a design system. In two or three lines, tell us what you did, what you inherited, and how others used it.

Avathon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Avathon is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us to discuss how we can assist you.
